messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] decode-gpu-oom spike detected in pool rdp-decode-pool-7 (node 10.3.7.21). 120s CUDA OOM rate > 15%. Affected model: redwood/bison-13b-4bit-unfused v2. Triage: page oncall.

Sam O'Neill: I'm oncall. Observing. @Alicia can you isolate that pool and route new streaming traffic away? Also need quick customer impact summary.

Alicia Chen: Pausing pool rdp-decode-pool-7 now. Using infractl: `./infractl pool pause --pool rdp-decode-pool-7 --reason "OOM surge" --drain 60s`

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Pool rdp-decode-pool-7 state -> PAUSED (drain mode). Active streams allowed to finish (60s grace).

Raj Patel: Quick triage: logs show many requests with `X-Max-Tokens: 100000` coming from the streaming SDK. Looks like runaway generation header. Correlating session ids.

Raj Patel: log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:20:11Z decode-node[pid=422]: session=abc123 max_tokens=100000 user=acct:acme stream=yes mem=24.2GB/24GB CUDA_OOM
2026-03-15T14:20:12Z decode-node[pid=422]: session=def456 max_tokens=120000 user=acct:yellowco stream=yes mem=24.5GB/24GB CUDA_OOM
```

Emily Rivera: Support update: Tickets created for customers: #12345 (Acme), #12346 (YellowCo). They reported truncated responses and 502s starting ~14:20 UTC. I'll keep them notified.

Sam O'Neill: Mitigation plan (live):
1) Quarantine pool (done).
2) Route new streaming requests in region -> fallback model bison-6b-8bit.
3) Apply gateway max_tokens cap = 4096 for streaming requests.
4) Evict long-running streams > 5m.
Applying steps 2/3 now.

Sam O'Neill: curl to update routing (executed):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/route/update \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${REDACTED}" \ 
  -d '{"pool":"rdp-decode-pool-7","fallback_model":"redwood/bison-6b-8bit","condition":"streaming"}'
```

infra-bot: Routing update accepted. New streaming routing: rdp-decode-pool-7 -> redwood/bison-6b-8bit (region us-west-2). Gateways applying token ceiling 4096.

Alicia Chen: Evicting sessions > 5m on pool rdp-decode-pool-7: `./streamsctl evict --pool rdp-decode-pool-7 --age 300 --force`

deploy-bot: Eviction started. 42 streams evicted. Observed immediate reduction in GPU memory pressure on nodes 10.3.7.21/22.

Sam O'Neill: Monitoring metrics: OOMs dropped to 0 in the last 2mins. Request drops fell from 3% -> 0.6% after routing. Still watching.

Emily Rivera: Updating tickets: Acme experiencing 1.2% request failures during window 14:20-15:02 UTC. YellowCo 0.9%. Adding note about SDK header anomaly and temporary credits proposed.

Raj Patel: Preparing hotfix: gateway will now ignore `X-Max-Tokens` > 10000 and cap to 4096 for streaming paths. Will roll in 5m. Patch: `gateway/filter/token_cap.go` (small change).

deploy-bot: Hotfix rollout started to gateway-service (3 nodes canary -> stable). No errors reported.

Sam O'Neill: Nice. Telemetry shows steady state. Current actions: keep pool paused (Alicia), route on fallback (infra), push SDK fix (Raj), customer comms (Emily).

Alicia Chen: Keeping pool paused. Starting controlled bringback plan: health-check based, 10% traffic test after 1h if stable.

Raj Patel: Pushed SDK PR to limit header and add unit test for header parsing. CI green. Tagging release for next non-urgent deploy.

Support Lead: Customer impact summary posted to #customer-impact: Acme (1.2% failures), YellowCo (0.9%). Proposed credits: 10% usage credit for incident window. Emily preparing customer-facing note.

Sam O'Neill: Post-incident actions (prelim):
- Root cause candidate: SDK regression allowing unbounded `max_tokens` header values leading to runaway generation and GPU OOM.
- Short-term: server-side hard cap, gateway anomaly alerts on token headers, eviction policy improvements.
- Mid-term: per-session token accounting, KV cache eviction improvements, add chaos tests for header abuse.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved: decode-gpu-oom-quarantine-1769554321. Duration 42m. Pager unassigned.

Emily Rivera: I'll send the customer update and credit proposal within 30 minutes.

Sam O'Neill: Thanks team. Quick notes for the postmortem doc: include timeline, affected customers, telemetry graphs, the logs above, commands we ran, and the SDK PR link.

Raj Patel: Adding monitoring rule: `alert.gateway.token_header_anomaly` threshold 15/min.

Alicia Chen: Will schedule pool health runbook update to cover emergency pause + bringback steps.

Sam O'Neill: 👍 overall. small follow-up: add a hard server-side token ceiling in the runtime (4000) so even twisted headers cannot drive GPU OOMs.

Support Lead: Customer notes updated and credits queued.

Sam O'Neill: Closing thread, copy to postmortems channel when draft ready. :thumbsup: :heart:
